source.name: Quranic Arabic Corpus morphology 0.4
source.qualification: Annotated corpus premises, not independently established universal Arabic grammar.

boundaries.phenomenon: Qualified perfect host and attached object for akrama
boundaries.observed_source: The source has perfect akrama stems with following object suffixes. A source lexical stem can be recognized, but the current person/attachment law requires an independently witnessed complete host before qualifying the object attachment and lexical valency.
boundaries.runtime_boundary: No independently qualified complete bare host is acquired by the current full-word filter. The discourse reader must not replace person_evidence by a lexical lemma/root match.
boundaries.future_requirement: A separately sourced and versioned host-projection/attachment law with exact source partitions, independent support and counterexamples; unchanged gold remains the evaluation target.

boundaries.phenomenon: Fronted man may be a subject or object
boundaries.runtime_boundary: Moving man to an object slot solely to obtain the expected binding would assume its grammatical role. An overt context-only name whose declension is unknown cannot by itself settle the competing subject/object analyses.
boundaries.future_requirement: Retain complete role alternatives and require independent case/frame evidence or unanimous source-relative answers; do not infer a role from the expected answer.

boundaries.phenomenon: Connected source form versus isolated imperative udkhul
boundaries.observed_source: The singular imperative source stem is spelled with alif al-wasl and a final connecting kasra, whereas the isolated target has initial damma and final sukun.
boundaries.runtime_boundary: The current complete-form person matcher does not license this written/connected-to-isolated transformation. A shared root and imperative annotation are not a transformation certificate.
boundaries.future_requirement: An independently sourced, versioned wasl/waqf transformation with exact domain, retained source bytes and form counterexamples. No assertion of compliance may follow from recognizing an imperative.

claims_not_made: These entries are not a complete inventory of remaining discourse failures.
They do not label the frozen expected Arabic sentences ungrammatical.
They do not waive failures, change gold, or certify complete Arabic coverage.
